# Nominal getter return slots

A reduced corpus of genuine Kotlin getter bytecodes combines a generic Reader getter with HashMap getters
whose identical nominal parameter has a distinct wrapper return descriptor.
The generic, nominal map, guarded Object and erased bridge bodies remain
separate. Java source discloses one local bridge name and its binary ABI and
reflection difference; the frozen observer receives that reported alias and
continues to check all four original dispatch routes and exact failures.

The runner preserves the full unmodified compiler output, then selects the
constructor and all four getters before baselining. Twenty unrelated Map
methods are omitted; every retained method_info byte and Code attribute,
constant-pool, field and class attribute remains identical to the compiler.
